report:
Typing in the notes box is no longer laggy. Each keystroke now renders only the notes component, in about 1 ms instead of about 153 ms.

## Cause

Two problems stacked up:

1. **State in the wrong place.** The notes text lived in `ChecklistScreen` (`useState('')`). Every keystroke re-rendered the whole screen, `FlashList` and every visible `QuestionRow`. `ChecklistScreen` renders each time because its `note` state changed. The rows re-render because the screen passes them a new `onAnswer` function on every render.
2. **Expensive work in every row.** `QuestionRow` calls `riskLevel()` on each render, and `riskLevel` (`src/lib/risk.ts`) built 200 passes × 31 `new RegExp(...)` objects per call. That cost about 8 ms per row.

## Fix

- New `src/components/NotesInput.tsx` owns the note text, the character counter and the Done button. `ChecklistScreen` now just renders `<NotesInput />` in the list footer.
- `riskLevel` now uses one precompiled regex. The old `hits / 200 >= 1` check only meant "some keyword matched". On all 48 checklist titles the new version gives the same result as the old one (25 high, 0 differences).

## Before and after

I used the React DevTools profiler while typing the same 22 characters at the same scroll position.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Commits | 44 | 22 |
| Total render time | 3,393 ms | 19 ms |
| `ChecklistScreen` renders | 22, avg 153.5 ms (max 240 ms) | 0 |
| `QuestionRow` renders | 396 (18 rows × 22), avg 8.1 ms | 0 |
| `FlashList` renders | 22, avg 152.6 ms | 0 |
| `Header` (image and `StatusBar`) renders | 22 | 0 |
| `NotesInput` renders | n/a | 22, avg 0.9 ms |

I also checked that typing works ("22 / 500" counter) and that answering a question still updates the header ("1 of 48 answered").

## Notes

- **Temporary setup, reverted.** RN 0.87.1 needs `agent-react-devtools` before DevTools can attach. I installed it with `--no-save` and ran `init`. I then ran `uninit`, removed the package, and restored `index.js` and `metro.config.js`. The diff now contains only the fix: `risk.ts`, `ChecklistScreen.tsx` and the new `NotesInput.tsx`.
- **Not done: stable `onAnswer`.** Wrapping `QuestionRow` in `memo` and making `onAnswer` stable would also stop rows re-rendering when you answer a question. That wasn't part of this bug, so I left it.
- **Baseline unavailable.** The baseline and after profiles (`/tmp/before.json`, `/tmp/after.json`) can be re-diffed with `agent-device react-devtools profile diff`.
